action: Sign in with valid test credentials.
expected_result: Dashboard loads without a blank screen or endless spinner.

action: Enter a wrong password and submit empty required fields.
expected_result: A clear error or field validation appears; the dashboard is not opened.

action: Refresh while signed in, then visit the dashboard while signed out.
expected_result: A valid session restores; signed-out access returns to Login.

action: Open each dashboard tab and Setup, Simulate, Results, and Verify. Collapse and reopen the workspace.
expected_result: The correct panel opens; inputs and results remain coherent.

action: Log out, use the browser Back button, then sign in again.
expected_result: Protected content requires a valid session; the app can be used again.

action: Select an orchard and inspect its name, boundaries, tree IDs/count, map and orthophoto.
expected_result: All belong to the selected orchard; overlays align and loading completes.

action: Switch orchard A → B → A, including after a completed simulation.
expected_result: Tree edits, weather context, observations, alerts and displayed results are associated with the appropriate orchard; stale A results are not presented as B results.

action: Refresh the orchard list and reload the page.
expected_result: The selected available orchard loads consistently; there is no duplicate orchard entry.

action: Change the saved orchard monitoring stage.
expected_result: The saved stage and live screening context update; this is distinguishable from temporary simulation-stage edits.

action: Upload a test orchard with a name, tree GeoJSON and orthophoto GeoTIFF; include DTM/DSM if available.
expected_result: Upload completes; the new orchard can be selected and its geometry/images are usable.

action: Try uploading with missing required files, malformed GeoJSON or an unsupported file.
expected_result: Validation/error feedback appears; no partial orchard is presented as a successful upload.

action: Select a tree and apply Healthy, Infected, Bagged, Dead, History Infected and Suspect in turn.
expected_result: The selected tree, status and legend update correctly; other trees are not unintentionally changed.

action: Set History/Suspect source presence to 0%, 50% and 100%; try an individual override and returning to defaults.
expected_result: The intended value is retained; 0% and 100% work; the saved run records the source basis and probability.

action: Change a source-bearing status to Healthy or Dead.
expected_result: An old source-probability override does not silently make that tree an active source.

action: Draw/apply stage and status zones, including overlap; cancel an unfinished polygon.
expected_result: Selected IDs/counts match the polygon; overlap follows the documented precedence; cancel changes nothing.

action: Compare Scenario only with Apply to orchard; reload after saving an orchard edit.
expected_result: Temporary edits remain identifiable as scenario edits; saved orchard edits persist and show saving/success/error feedback.

action: Add management and Cecid habitat/weed zones; remove one, undo where offered, and cancel a clear-all confirmation.
expected_result: The intended zone changes; overlays and inventory agree; cancelling does not delete zones.

action: Inspect the map at the first and last simulation frames and compare with input statuses.
expected_result: Simulated infestation is not silently written back as an observed orchard status.

action: Select Live Forecast; inspect coordinates, dates, units and source label.
expected_result: Weather belongs to the orchard and exposes its source/fallback; missing cloud/radiation is not labelled zero or fabricated.

action: Switch Live Forecast → Custom weather → Live Forecast.
expected_result: The active mode is clear; the next request uses the selected mode rather than stale values.

action: Set custom temperature, wind speed/direction, rainfall, duration and local start time, including zero rainfall/wind.
expected_result: Entered values and Philippine-time dates survive the request, playback and saved result; wind direction means wind-from.

action: Build several weather periods; test an overlap and an uncovered hour.
expected_result: Period boundaries are correct; later-period precedence and uncovered-hour defaults are disclosed.

action: Compare bright sunshine, intermittent sun and dim/overcast daylight, with observed/assumed basis.
expected_result: The exact choice and basis are saved; cloud percentage alone or tree shade does not guarantee dim outdoor light.

action: Compare dry soil, moist at Hour 0 and recently wet context for Cecid.
expected_result: Soil state/context is retained; moist at Hour 0 does not manufacture antecedent rainfall.

action: Change custom settings, load a saved template, and inspect every period and soil/light field.
expected_result: Saved inputs replace the relevant current controls; stale editor settings do not contaminate the replay.

action: Complete runs A–D from the four-combination table.
expected_result: Each run identifies the correct pest, engine, stage, source scenario, weather, duration and model version.

action: Run short, 48-hour and maximum-duration scenarios offered by the UI.
expected_result: The supported duration is honored; times and frame labels are coherent. Record elapsed time instead of assuming a speed target.

action: Click Run Simulation repeatedly while a run is pending.
expected_result: Running feedback is visible; repeated clicks do not submit accidental duplicate runs.

action: Switch pest/engine after a result, then run again.
expected_result: New inputs produce a new correctly labelled result; the previous pest/engine is not mixed into it.

action: Compare observation-seeded and non-observation-seeded runs using labelled test records.
expected_result: Only intended orchard/pest/date-range observations affect source setup; source provenance explains their use.

action: Run with outside pressure disabled, then add north/east/opposing neighbor sources and remove them again.
expected_result: Each direction/level survives saving; removing all neighbors disables outside pressure; Cecid displays its exposure-proxy limitation.

action: Compare untreated, protective, sanitation and combined treatment scenarios with the same seed.
expected_result: Correct targets and source/incoming factors are saved; recommendations do not silently become observed treatment records.

action: Inspect source/reservoir badges, tree details and map legends.
expected_result: Badges describe initial source scenarios; new infestation is not automatically labelled an adult source; cells and trees are distinguished where relevant.

action: Run one realization, then 5 or 9 repeated runs. Toggle Across runs and One run.
expected_result: Frequency is labelled as repeated-run frequency; one-run totals and playback remain representative outcomes.

action: Compare the map, Overview, spread/weather charts and Results at the same point in the run.
expected_result: Figures refer to their stated frame/final result and units; unexplained contradictory totals are logged.

action: Play, pause, step backward/forward, drag the slider and restart at the end.
expected_result: Hour, weather, map state and counts agree; playback stops at the last frame and does not run past it.

action: Inspect Dead, Bagged and out-of-stage trees.
expected_result: Dead trees are excluded from new infestation; bagging reduces modeled pressure; unsuitable targets do not receive that pest's establishment outcome.

action: Change crop-impact assumptions and compare displayed calculations/report values.
expected_result: Units and arithmetic agree; estimated loss/savings are labelled as scenario estimates rather than measured benefits.

action: Find the completed run in History; refresh and revisit after signing in again.
expected_result: The run is retained in the available storage path; browser-cache fallback is clearly identified if server storage is unavailable.

action: Filter History by orchard and run date/month; change grouping and export the filtered history.
expected_result: Displayed/exported entries match the chosen filters and scope; execution date is not confused with custom forecast start date.

action: Choose Load Result while current controls/map belong to another setup.
expected_result: The original saved output, orchard, metadata and frames load; this action does not create a new simulation.

action: Choose Use as Template, inspect restored inputs, and rerun without New random seed.
expected_result: For the same model version and exact saved inputs/weather, outputs reproduce. Loading controls alone does not start a run.

action: Open a v16 result/template if available.
expected_result: Stored results retain v16 identification; a newly executed v17 run is identified as v17 and is not promised to reproduce the old engine.

action: Export Excel for one run and Export History for several runs; open both files.
expected_result: Files open, identify the correct run/orchard/model, and contain consistent values and weather/seed metadata where supplied.

action: Print a final-result report while playback displays an earlier hour; also choose displayed-hour reporting.
expected_result: The default report uses final results; displayed-hour reporting uses its selected frame/map/weather and labels that hour.

action: Add report notes/name, export portrait PDF, cancel once, then retry.
expected_result: Map/orthophoto, text, legend and saved model assumptions are legible; notes do not break layout; cancelling permits retry.

area: Field verification, alerts and account settings
action: Select a tree and choose Log field verification; inspect Verify.
expected_result: Orchard/tree/pest and optional forecast/run link are correct; recording an observation does not fabricate a forecast result.

area: Field verification, alerts and account settings
action: Save labelled test observations for Present, Absent and Not inspected; inspect their history.
expected_result: Date, method, observer, counts and notes persist correctly; Not inspected is not interpreted as pest absence.

area: Field verification, alerts and account settings
action: Enter affected count greater than inspected count, invalid counts or missing required fields.
expected_result: Validation prevents invalid observations from being reported as successfully saved.

area: Field verification, alerts and account settings
action: Open an orchard's forecast alert and apply its suggested simulation setup.
expected_result: The correct orchard and scenario are prepared; screening is labelled screening and no simulation starts automatically.

area: Field verification, alerts and account settings
action: Acknowledge and resolve a test alert, then refresh and switch orchards.
expected_result: The intended alert's status persists; unrelated orchard alerts are not changed.

area: Field verification, alerts and account settings
action: Edit the test account's profile, test password mismatch/current-password errors, and test recovery using its mailbox.
expected_result: Validation and success/error messages are clear; successful changes persist; invalid or reused reset credentials are rejected.

area: Field verification, alerts and account settings
action: Exercise cloud sync in the configured test environment, then refresh History.
expected_result: Success/failure feedback reflects the actual sync; runs are not duplicated or assigned the wrong orchard. Mark Blocked if the service cannot be tested.

action: Cecid: use moist soil, fruitlets, a nearby target and a favorable dry dim-day/twilight window.
expected_result: Local emergence and exposure are possible during eligible hours; sources and assumed laying/lifespan settings are identifiable.

action: Cecid: schedule 4 hours of heavier rain, then 1 dry favorable hour, then rain and another favorable break.
expected_result: Suitable breaks can permit emergence/movement; heavier rain pauses activity; surviving adults do not disappear merely because rain resumes.

action: Cecid: compare bright versus explicitly dim daylight, darkness, and unsuitable host stage.
expected_result: Bright/dark/unsuitable conditions close the applicable activity or host gate; cloud cover or canopy shade alone does not override it.

action: Run the explicit zero-source setup below for both pests and engines.
expected_result: Active local sources and outside pressure are zero; no new infestation is generated. Do not use a fallback-source scenario as this test.

action: Fruit Fly: use mature fruit and compare daytime with reduced dark-period activity.
expected_result: The model allows reduced assumed dark activity; it is not an exclusive twilight model, and unsuitable fruitlet targets remain excluded.

action: Fruit Fly: inspect a source–target–remote-target chain with no independent source at the middle/remote tree.
expected_result: New infestation does not create outgoing adult pressure. The automated source-progression regression is the precise check if UI geometry makes the chain ambiguous.

action: Compare source-presence endpoints and bagged/treated targets under matched inputs.
expected_result: Source assumptions affect eligibility/pressure; zero source probability stays absent. Protection modifies risk without promising immunity.

action: Interrupt API access during a test run or save, restore it and retry.
expected_result: An actionable failure appears, no false success is shown, loading ends, and retry works without silently losing or duplicating records.

action: Interrupt live-weather/map-tile access and try history loading from saved browser data.
expected_result: Unavailable/fallback states are explicit; the app does not claim a complete offline live-weather/basemap capability.

action: Switch orchards quickly while weather/history loads; navigate between tabs while a simulation completes.
expected_result: Late responses cannot replace the active orchard's inputs/results with another orchard's data.

action: Refresh while edits are unsaved or a run is pending; then check History.
expected_result: Unsaved work is not falsely presented as saved; completed records and failures are identifiable; retry does not silently duplicate them.

action: Resize to a narrow window, use keyboard navigation and open/close upload, weather, settings and report dialogs.
expected_result: Controls remain reachable; focus, scrolling and Escape/close behavior work; no trapped or hidden Run/Export button.

action: Repeat a run → result → history → report cycle several times.
expected_result: No accumulating duplicate UI entries, frozen playback, stuck loading state, or steadily worsening interaction.
